basic_details.job_title: NeGD Business Analyst Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: National e-Governance Division (NeGD) is recruiting candidates for 2 Business Analyst vacancies on a contract basis under advertisement number N-21013/9/2024-NeGD for its 2026 recruitment drive. Eligible applicants must possess a B.Tech, MBA, or M.Tech degree with specialization in Information Systems, Business Analytics, or Computer Applications. Candidates whose age is maximum 55 years on 25 October 2026 can apply online through the official portal. The last date for submission of applications is 25 October 2026. The selection process involves screening of applications based on qualification

how_to_apply: Visit the official application portal at https://ora.digitalindiacorporation.in/.
Register and fill out the online application form for the Business Analyst position.
Provide all required educational and experience details as specified in the notification.
Submit the application online on or before the last date, which is 25.10.2026.
important_instructions: Candidates already in regular or contractual employment under Central/State Government, Public Sector Undertakings, or Autonomous Bodies must apply through the proper channel, attach a 'No Objection Certificate' from their employer, or produce it at the time of interview. NeGD reserves the right to fill all, some, or none of the positions advertised without assigning any reason. The positions are purely temporary for the project of NeGD/DIC, and appointees shall not derive any right or claim for permanent appointment. NeGD reserves the right to terminate appointments with one month's notice or without notice by paying one month's salary in lieu thereof. Selected candidates' designations will be mapped as per the existing designation policy of NeGD. For queries, candidates can contact the HR Team at Electronics Niketan, New Delhi, or email [email protected].

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfill the educational qualification and experience criteria stipulated for the Business Analyst (AI) position: Educational Qualification: B.Tech / MBA / M.Tech with specialization in Information Systems, Business Analytics, or Computer Applications. Preferred Certifications: CBAP, CCBA, or equivalent business analysis credentials. Experience: 5–8 years in business analysis, requirement elicitation, and documentation, including at least 2–3 years working on AI/ML-based or digital transformation initiatives, 3–5 years in requirements gathering, process analysis, and stakeholder management. Experience engaging with government clients is preferred. Age Limit: The maximum age limit shall be 55 years on the closing date of receipt of application (25.10.2026).

content_sections.heading: NeGD Business Analyst Job Description
content_sections.text: Selected candidates for the Business Analyst (AI) position will be responsible for the following duties: Gather and document functional and business requirements from government departments and stakeholders. Translate requirements into user stories, acceptance criteria, and workflow diagrams for AI/ML implementation. Support Solution Architect in mapping technical deliverables with user needs. Validate solution outputs and ensure usability, accessibility, and adherence to MeitY standards. Conduct stakeholder workshops and facilitate UAT sessions for AI solutions. Maintain documentation, change request logs, and requirement traceability matrices. Analyze citizen service data, identify process improvement opportunities, and propose AI integration use cases.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NeGD Business Analyst
content_sections.text: Visit the official application portal at https://ora.digitalindiacorporation.in/ . Register and fill out the online application form for the Business Analyst position. Provide all required educational and experience details as specified in the notification. Submit the application online on or before the last date, which is 25.10.2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Screening of applications will be based on qualifications, age, and relevant experience. NeGD reserves the right to fix a higher threshold of qualifications and experience for screening to limit the number of candidates for interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be invited for interviews.
